{{Infobox map |name=The Aztec Ruins |year=2024 |image=Ruin_thumb.jpg |creator={{player|infiniti|flag=ca}} {{player|alice|flag=se}} |gametype=4on4 |size=large |download=https://maps.quakeworld.nu/core/aztek.bsp |loc=https://discord.com/channels/900693190254948362/1232605333277638716/1233122087540097034 }} '''Aztek''' is a 4on4 TDM map by {{player|infiniti|flag=ca}} and {{player|alice|flag=se}}.
=== Key Features === *'''Slime Tunnels ([https://quake.fandom.com/wiki/Biosuit Biosuit]):''' On the far end of the map is an old tunnel system, filled with toxic slime. One Biosuit is placed near the tunnel entrance at RL for protection. A hidden room sits above the tunnel, holding an additional LG, and a button. Pressing this button unlocks the Pentagram.   * '''[[Pentagram of Protection]] :''' At the start of a match the Pentagram is locked/inaccessible. It unlocks when the button in the hidden room above the slime tunnels is pressed. Once unlocked, it remains accessible for the rest of the match.
